tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You have recently discovered a beautiful park for long walks near your university campus. You think your friend Alex would enjoy the experience and you want to invite them to join you on an upcoming weekend. Write an email to Alex.
bullets: Describe the park and what makes it special.
Invite Alex to join you for a walk in the park during an upcoming weekend.
Suggest to Alex what they should prepare for the trip.
tasks.subject: Weekend adventure
